agent_actions_confirmation_check.name: agent_actions_confirmation_check
agent_actions_confirmation_check.value: "agent_action_proposals"."status" in ('PROPOSED','CANCELLED','EXPIRED') or ("agent_action_proposals"."confirmed_at" is not null and "agent_action_proposals"."confirmation_authorization_version" is not null and "agent_action_proposals"."confirmation_role_assignment_snapshot" is not null)

agent_learning_approval_bundle_check.name: agent_learning_approval_bundle_check
agent_learning_approval_bundle_check.value: "agent_learning_candidates"."status" in ('QUARANTINED','REJECTED') or ("agent_learning_candidates"."applicability" is not null and "agent_learning_candidates"."regression_case_id" is not null and "agent_learning_candidates"."validation_checksum" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and "agent_learning_candidates"."approved_by_user_id" is not null and "agent_learning_candidates"."approved_at" is not null)

agent_learning_promotion_check.name: agent_learning_promotion_check
agent_learning_promotion_check.value: "agent_learning_candidates"."status" not in ('PROMOTED','REVOKED') or ("agent_learning_candidates"."promoted_by_user_id" is not null and "agent_learning_candidates"."promoted_at" is not null)

agent_plan_completion_time_check.name: agent_plan_completion_time_check
agent_plan_completion_time_check.value: "agent_plan_executions"."completed_at" is null or "agent_plan_executions"."started_at" is null or "agent_plan_executions"."completed_at" >= "agent_plan_executions"."started_at"
